Level 3 - Intermediate 30 min CRED

From Use Cases to Classes (Nouns & Verbs)

The interviewer reads you a paragraph of requirements. Five minutes later you need a list of classes that is small, correct and easy to defend. This page gives you a repeatable method: find the actors, list the use cases, pull out the nouns and verbs, then sort every noun into entity, value object, enum, attribute or "drop it". You will also learn the one mistake that gets candidates rejected even when their code runs: one class per instance.
